sections.evidence: Verified secure Siri/Apple Home accessory integration and setup/configuration/automation/support roles.
Checked hierarchy, accessible room/zone/home detail, multi-home support and no duplicate Home settings.

Checked names without size/location attributes and grouped voice control.
Verified physical accessories/categories, switches matching controlled type, independent services, characteristic attributes, meaningful UI names, Siri service naming and grouped service control.

Verified optional multiroom grouping.

Verified source no additional platform-specific rules without treating it as uniform API availability.
